item.description: For WrappedCBDC, bringing the naira on-chain was a way to digitise the currency's value, despite its historical volatility (with wild swings seen between 2023 and 2024). cNGN is backed by cash deposits held in local bank accounts (for easy liquidation) and short-term securities, keeping assets that are pegged 1:1 to the naira onshore.
